name: City of Orlando Summer Youth Employment
org: City of Orlando with CareerSource Central Florida
what_you_do: Take a short class on job skills, then work a paid summer job with a local business or nonprofit. The city youth work team mentors you.
who_can_apply: Orlando residents ages 15 to 19. Go to an open house. Bring a birth certificate, a signed Social Security card, and a school or Florida ID.
pay_detail: Paid work experience (rate not stated on the program page)
duration: About 5 weeks in 2025; length for 2026 not stated
deadline_text: The 2026 summer cohort application is closed. Open houses ran March 9 to 12, 2026 at city neighborhood centers. Expect a similar spring window for 2027 (not posted).
how_to_apply: Go to an open house at a neighborhood center with your documents. Contact youthworkforce@orlando.gov.
notes: The 2025 city release called it paid, five week internships. The city also runs a year round version for residents 15 to 19 that was not read in detail.
